_notes: Life-story 'Where will you be born this time?' — Miami, 80s neon style. Every spoken sentence contains 'bloody'. #swear# words are bleeped in the main mix and masked in captions.

Facts: ~224k Florida births/yr vs ~132M world births (≈1 in 600); Julia Tuttle founded Miami (the only major US city founded by a woman); Miami Beach has the world's largest collection of Art Deco architecture; 'sunny day' king-tide flooding through storm drains; cold-stunned iguanas fall from trees; cafecito from a ventanita; Hurricane Andrew 1992; stone crab season Oct 15 – May 1; Cuban sandwiches; Pitbull ('Mr. 305') is from Miami; US life expectancy ~78 (CDC, 2023).
